description: Search every collection at once: Georgia General Assembly bills (every version) and amendments, Supreme Court of Georgia opinions, the Official Code of Georgia Annotated and the Georgia and U.S. constitutions, and machine transcripts of House and Senate meetings. Plain-language questions work: results are ranked by meaning as well as by words. Returns documents with their best passages (each with a citation `version_id#start-end` and a deep link), facet counts to narrow by, the interpretation used (identifiers found, places, bodies), a confidence band, and coverage notes that say when the records asked about are not held. Empty `query` with filters browses. `mode: all` lists every match found, sorted by date, a page at a time with `cursor` and a total of what was found.

Filters.description: Hard filters. Every field is optional; values come from the vocabularies.

action.description: Stage of an action inside a meeting: reading, motion, vote, adopted, failed, public_comment, ...
action.title: Action

body.description: Issuing bodies by id, e.g. ga-supreme-court, ga-senate, ga-house-rules (describe_site lists them).
body.title: Body

body_type.description: Kinds of body: legislative_chamber, legislative_committee, court, board_of_education, governing_body, ...
body_type.title: Body Type

date_field.description: Which date the range applies to; defaults to each type's own (filing date for opinions, meeting date for meetings).
date_field.title: Date Field

date_from.description: Earliest date: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.
date_from.title: Date From

date_to.description: Latest date: YYYY, YYYY-MM, or YYYY-MM-DD.
date_to.title: Date To

doc_type.description: Document types, e.g. bill, opinion, code_section, constitution_provision, meeting_transcript, amendment.
doc_type.title: Doc Type

include_overlapping.description: With place: also bodies whose area overlaps it (Fulton and DeKalb for Atlanta).
include_overlapping.title: Include Overlapping

level.description: Levels of government: federal, state, county, municipal, consolidated, school_district, regional.
level.title: Level

place.description: A Georgia place in words or as an id (Atlanta, Cobb County, city:savannah). Matches the body's jurisdiction.
place.title: Place

place_scope.description: With place: documents issued for that place (jurisdiction), documents that mention it (mentions), or either (default).
place_scope.title: Place Scope

status.description: Status classes: pending, passed_one_chamber, passed_both, enacted, vetoed, failed, in_force, repealed, decided, held.
status.title: Status

Filters.title: Filters

cursor.description: The next_cursor of a previous call, for the next page.
cursor.title: Cursor

filters.description: Optional hard filters (see describe_site for values).

limit.description: Results per page: 1 to 50 (default 10 documents; 25 in mode all).
limit.title: Limit

linked_to.description: Only documents linked to this document id (a bill's meetings, a section's amending bills).
linked_to.title: Linked To

mode.description: best: ranked and cut. all: every match found, by date, paged, with a total.
mode.title: Mode

parent.description: Only documents inside this hierarchy node (code:t16, code:t16/c11, ga-const:art-i).
parent.title: Parent

query.description: A question or keywords, in plain language. Empty with filters: browse.
query.title: Query

relations.description: With linked_to: relation types (discusses, amends, amendment_to, cites, ...).
relations.title: Relations

versions.description: current (default) or all versions (how a bill changed).
versions.title: Versions

name: search

summary.description: Georgia Commons' AI-written summary: labeled, never source text.
summary.title: Summary

title: Search Georgia's public documents
